objective.statement: The clock toggle button label must reflect the view it switches to: "24 hour view" while the clock is in 12 hour mode.

complexity.rationale: One label expression in one component, with one component test.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: When the clock is in 12 hour mode, the toggle button text reads "24 hour view".
When the clock is in 24 hour mode (the default), the toggle button text still reads "12 hour view".

in.statement: Toggle button label in src/components/clock/Clock.tsx (rendered by HomeView).

out.statement: Time formatting, aria-pressed behaviour, styling and HomeView layout.

observations.statement: Clock.tsx renders the literal text "12 hour view" regardless of hourCycle.
The card names HomeView.tsx, but the button lives in the Clock component that HomeView renders; the fix is made there. The request's doubled quote in ""24 hour view" is read as a typo.

provenance.source: Bug Fix card: Clock Button Text Fix

capabilityOwners.rationale: Owns the toggle button and its label.

unit.rationale: No pure logic changes; formatClock is untouched.

component.rationale: The label is rendered output of the Clock component.

integration.rationale: No API or cross-module contract changes.

e2e.rationale: Covered by the component test; no new journey.

increments.behavior: Toggle button label shows the view it switches to.
increments.doneWhen: Component tests for both labels pass and the existing suite stays green.

tests.description: Toggle button reads "12 hour view" by default and "24 hour view" after being pressed.

expectedRedEvidence.expectedFailure: Button text is still "12 hour view" after toggling.
expectedRedEvidence.observedFailure: Expected toggle to have text "24 hour view"; received "12 hour view".

verification.requirement: Clock component tests and the full suite pass.
verification.result: unit 30 passed, component 43 passed; npm run lint exit 0
